faqs.question: Which is better for my business: Square or Wave?
faqs.answer: Choose based on the workflow you need most. For expense management, test receipt capture, approvals, reimbursement and accounting handoff; for payment acceptance or point-of-sale, test checkout, payment methods, hardware, settlement and reporting. The stored pick is provisional and not an independently verified ranking.

faqs.question: How should I compare pricing?
faqs.answer: Check current plan eligibility in your country, subscription fees, transaction fees, add-ons, billing cadence and usage limits. A free or low-entry plan may not include every feature you need. Calculate total cost using your actual monthly volume and confirm the terms directly with each vendor.

faqs.question: Can I use Square and Wave together?
faqs.answer: Possibly, if they serve distinct workflows or a supported integration connects them. Confirm integration availability for your plans, decide which system is the source of truth, and test data sync, duplicate entry and reconciliation before rollout.

faqs.question: What should I test before choosing?
faqs.answer: Run a short pilot using real tasks: complete the core workflow, test permissions and exports, verify integrations, and document limitations and support needs. Compare the results with a written checklist instead of relying only on the stored score.
